title: Privacy Policy & Zero-Upload Architecture
description: Privacy practices, live browser-local zero-upload BOM checker and calculators, static hosting telemetry, Google AdSense cookies, and Amazon/Coupang affiliate disclosure for Pin2Pin Global.

sections.heading: Zero-Upload Engineering Tool Philosophy (Live Client-Side Execution)
paragraphs: Hardware engineers routinely work on confidential schematics, proprietary power budgets, and pre-release Bills of Materials (BOMs). Pin2Pin Global is architected from the ground up as a static web application with 100% browser-local computation.

All live interactive engineering tools — including the Zero-Upload Client-Side BOM Checker, Interactive Freeform Part-vs-Part Comparator, Package Pinout Trap Matrix, LDO Thermal Margin Calculator, DC-DC Efficiency & Inductor Ripple Calculator, Op-Amp GBWP & Slew-Rate Checker, and parametric catalog filters — execute entirely inside your local browser JavaScript runtime. Your design inputs, operating voltages, load currents, and uploaded BOM CSV files are never transmitted to, logged by, or stored on Pin2Pin Global servers.
bullets: No user account or registration is required to browse part profiles, run side-by-side comparisons, screen BOM CSV files, or use engineering calculators.
BOM CSV files dropped into the live Zero-Upload BOM Checker are parsed strictly in local browser memory via client-side JavaScript and are cleared immediately when you close or reload the tab.
Zero proprietary design files, MPN lists, or BOM tables leave your device over the network.

sections.heading: Information Collected Automatically (Static Hosting & Analytics)
paragraphs: Pin2Pin Global is delivered via static web hosting infrastructure (including GitHub Pages static site delivery and standard CDN edge caching). Hosting providers may record standard, transient HTTP access logs (such as IP address, user-agent string, and requested URL) to maintain service reliability and prevent abuse.

To understand which part comparisons, field guides, and calculators are most useful and detect broken links, Pin2Pin Global uses Google Analytics 4 (GA4 Measurement ID: G-Q51M6YDXDR) to collect aggregated, non-sensitive interaction telemetry — including page URLs visited, referring domain, approximate country-level region, device viewport/browser type, and anonymized UI events (such as calculator usage, search selections, or outbound datasheet/distributor clicks). We never log BOM contents or calculator numerical inputs to analytics, and we never sell personal data.

sections.heading: Google AdSense & Third-Party Advertising Cookies
paragraphs: Pin2Pin Global uses Google AdSense (Publisher ID: ca-pub-8587506565277191) to display clearly separated, layout-stable advertisements that help fund ongoing datasheet verification and site maintenance.

Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this website or other websites on the internet. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to users based on their visit to Pin2Pin Global and other sites.
bullets: You may opt out of personalized advertising at any time by visiting Google Ads Settings (https://adssettings.google.com) or the Network Advertising Initiative opt-out page (https://optout.networkadvertising.org).
You can block or delete cookies through your browser preferences without restricting access to any Pin2Pin Global part specs, SVG pinout diagrams, BOM checker, or calculators.

Users in the European Economic Area (EEA), UK, California, and South Korea retain full statutory privacy rights to inquire about or request deletion of any personal correspondence voluntarily submitted to us.

sections.heading: Outbound Links, GitHub Issues & Affiliate Partners (Amazon & Coupang)
paragraphs: Pages on Pin2Pin Global contain outbound links to official semiconductor manufacturer websites, electronic component distributors (DigiKey, Mouser, LCSC search deeplinks without scraping), contextual lab-gear affiliate partners — including the Amazon Services LLC Associates Program (Associate ID: kbu3986-20) and Coupang Partners (Partner ID: AF2200875) — and our public GitHub Issues tracker for error reporting. Clicking an outbound link takes you to an external website governed by that third party's own privacy policy and cookie practices.

If you voluntarily submit a pinout or specification error report via GitHub Issues (https://github.com/kbu3986/pin2pin-global/issues) or secondary email (engineering@pin2pin.dev), your GitHub username or email address is used strictly to investigate, verify, and respond to your technical report.

sections.heading: Policy Updates & Privacy Contact
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically as new static features or compliance requirements take effect. The revision date at the top of this page always reflects the latest active version. For privacy questions or data deletion requests, please open a request via GitHub Issues (https://github.com/kbu3986/pin2pin-global/issues) or email engineering@pin2pin.dev.
